name: MCP for Blender
what: A community plugin (formerly blender-mcp) that connects Blender to any LLM through MCP. A Blender add-on runs a local socket server and the MCP server sends it commands, so the AI can create and edit objects, materials and scenes. Third-party, not made by Blender. MIT licensed.
who: Game artists and indie devs who want to block out 3D scenes or props by prompting.

setup.text: One-command setup on macOS/Linux (installs uv if needed, configures your MCP clients and the Blender add-on):
Already have uv? Run setup directly, or add it to Claude Code by hand:
setup.code:
uvx mcp-for-blender setup
# or
claude mcp add blender uvx mcp-for-blender

setup.text: Fully quit and reopen your AI app, then open Blender. The add-on can run Python code inside Blender, so save your work first.

prompts: Create a low-poly campfire scene with logs, rocks and a warm point light.
Make a stylized treasure chest and give it a wood and gold material.
Set up a camera that orbits the scene and render a preview.
